description: This file declares functions, structures, and classes related to in-game actions and commands for the Wesnoth game, including unit recruitment, battle evaluation, movement, victory conditions, and shroud management.

classes.name: battle_stats
classes.description: Structure holding statistics for a potential battle, including hit chances, damage, special effects, and other combat modifiers.

classes.name: battle_stats_strings
classes.description: Structure containing string representations of battle statistics for display or logging.

classes.name: undo_action
classes.description: Structure to record information for undoing a movement or action, including route, affected unit, and position data.

methods.name: can_recruit_on
methods.description: Checks if recruitment is possible on a specific map location.

methods.name: recruit_unit
methods.description: Recruits a unit into the game at a specified location, with options for display and constraints.

methods.name: evaluate_battle_stats
methods.description: Calculates and returns battle statistics between attacker and defender, optionally including detailed strings.

methods.name: attack
methods.description: Executes an attack action between two locations.

methods.name: village_owner
methods.description: Returns the index of the team that owns a village at a given location.

methods.name: get_village
methods.description: Assigns ownership of a village at a location to a specified team, possibly triggering events.

methods.name: find_leader
methods.description: Finds the leader unit of a specified side.

methods.name: calculate_healing
methods.description: Calculates healing for units at the start of a side’s turn.

methods.name: get_advanced_unit
methods.description: Returns an advanced version of a unit at a location.

methods.name: advance_unit
methods.description: Advances a unit at a location to a specified upgraded unit.

methods.name: under_leadership
methods.description: Checks if a unit is under leadership effects and returns the leader's location.

methods.name: check_victory
methods.description: Checks for victory conditions and throws an exception if met.

methods.name: timeofday_at
methods.description: Gets the time of day at a specific map location.

methods.name: combat_modifier
methods.description: Returns damage multiplier based on time of day and unit alignment.

methods.name: move_unit
methods.description: Moves a unit along a sequence of locations, with undo and replay support.

methods.name: recalculate_fog
methods.description: Recalculates fog of war based on unit positions.

methods.name: clear_shroud
methods.description: Removes shroud for a team based on current unit positions.

methods.name: apply_shroud_changes
methods.description: Applies pending shroud changes stored in undo stack.

methods.name: unit_can_move
methods.description: Checks if a unit at a location can make any move.
